# RFC-0017: Two identifiers in both lists

## Abstract

Two identifiers appear in updates and in obsoletes, so L05 reports twice.

## Motivation

One finding cannot expose a nondeterministic order; two can.

## Proposal

Described here.

## Alternatives considered

None.
